evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Maintain high standards of data quality and governance, implementing validation, monitoring, and documentation to ensure trusted and well-understood datasets.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes data quality, governance, validation, monitoring, and reliability throughout with no velocity/speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: helping organisations understand and reduce their environmental impact
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors here affect business/ESG decision-making for customers without direct regulatory or financial-reporting consequence to EcoOnline itself, so moderate.

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The team is actively modernising an existing architecture and expanding capabilities (not building from zero), with named tools already in production, placing it at mid maturity.

evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools (Airflow, dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, QuickSight) with precise application context make the day-to-day work concrete, so hiring_manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Design and manage analytics-ready data models and datasets that support dashboards, reporting, and product features across the ESG platform.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's outputs directly feed the ESG product platform and its features, placing this in product-oriented stakeholder territory.
evidence.autonomy_level: Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to integrate data capabilities into the ESG platform and support the delivery of new analytics features.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities are framed around developing, delivering, and supporting features within an existing platform roadmap rather than setting direction, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is mentioned only as an internal interview note-taking tool used by the company, not as a skill or tool expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Maintain high standards of data quality and governance, implementing validation, monitoring, and documentation to ensure trusted and well-understood datasets.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality/validation is framed as an owned responsibility with an action verb ("implementing validation, monitoring"), so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Maintain high standards of data quality and governance, implementing validation, monitoring, and documentation to ensure trusted and well-understood datasets.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and trust in datasets is a recurring concern but framed alongside delivery of features and dashboards rather than dominating the role, so moderate.
